decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the connector names, controls, signal assignments, and on-board BOOT-button policy.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records the panel reset connection to EN/GND and the on-board development-only BOOT button.
The GPIO assignments do not change the selected ESP32-S3 family or ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 module.
The source lists panel-control and touch GPIOs but does not change the addressable LED data GPIO, power supply, standby control, or level shifting.
The source does not mention or revise 5V_EN; the candidate's existing GPIO5 enable assignment remains unchanged.
Assigning panel and touch input GPIOs does not alter DCDC1 voltage regulation, current rating, or its normal-operation loads.
The source does not change I2C pins, pull-ups, cable assumptions, series resistors, or signal-conditioning topology.
The panel and touch GPIO list does not change the USB auxiliary regulator, activation condition, powered rail, source selection, or standalone-programming behavior.
The source does not revise the USB data lines or the USB-C programming-port role.
The listed main-board panel controls and touch connectors do not alter the separate sensor board's external-sensor fanout role.
The source does not mention or revise the GPIO13 charge-status LED chain or the dedicated external charge-LED interface.
Panel-control GPIO assignments do not affect battery protection requirements, cutoff voltages, or protection components.
